title: Prospective randomized crossover study evaluating a digital decision-support tool for interpretation of cerebrospinal fluid neurodegeneration biomarkers among neurologists
summary: This study investigates whether a digital interpretation tool can support neurologists in preparing clinical reports and interpreting laboratory values from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Participants assess several standardized case scenarios containing biomarker values used in the diagnostic evaluation of neurodegenerative diseases. Some cases are assessed conventionally, while others are evaluated with the support of a digital tool. The order is randomized. Outcomes include the quality of the interpretation and the time required to complete the assessment. No real treatment decisions are made, and the study has no impact on patient care. The scenarios are based on real-world cases but do not correspond directly to identifiable real laboratory reports.

interventions.name: Participants first interpret standardized clinical case vignettes containing cerebrospinal fluid biomarker results without digital decision support.
